{{Quote|When you travel the universe with Qui-Gon Jinn, you tend to learn a few things.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on his ability to understand the language|<ref name="Clone Wars 23">{{CW|23}}</ref>}}
'''Nelvaanese''' was the native language of the [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanian]] species from [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]].

[[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] traders incorporated Nelvaanese phrases into trade dialects that could be found in the vicinity of Nelvaan.<ref name="Nelvaan" /> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] learned some of these dialects while he was traveling with [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]].<ref name="Clone Wars 23" />

{{Language-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nelvaanese is based on [[Wikipedia:Hungarian language|Hungarian]], probably because [[Genndy Tartakovsky]]'s wife is from Hungary. <br />
Some phrases from ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' are:

*''Az ördög az enyém, mindent elrontottál. Ez volt az én próbám'' - The devil is mine. You ruined everything. It was my trial.

*''Elrontottátok a tesztet.'' - You messed up the test. (Here, "you" is plural)

*''Meg kell ezt beszélnünk Anakitusz szellemével.'' - We must discuss this with the spirit of Anakitus.

*''Holt Kezed'' - your dead hand

*''Ez egy kicsit fájni fog.'' - This will hurt a bit.

''Apu'' - daddy, father, colloqiual

*''[[Orvos]]'' - doctor

*''Nem tudtál? Nem tudtál így beszélni?'' - Couldn't you? Couldn't speak this tongue?

The speech of mutated Nelvaanians sounds notably different and is based on [[Wikipedia:Russian language|Russian]], which is [[Genndy Tartakovsky]]'s native language. <br />
Some phrases are:

*''Ya dolzhen eto ubrat'' ("Я должен это убрать") - I must remove this.

*''Ne mozhem bolshe terpet'' ("Не можем больше терпеть") - We cannot tolerate this any longer.

*''My mozhem idti domoy. Idyom domoy!" ("Мы можем идти домой. Идем домой!") - We can go home. Let's go home!

*''Wam tuda'' ("Вам туда") - That way.
